newsitem.title: USA: Phoenix completes $2.5 mln private placement.
newsitem.headline: Phoenix completes $2.5 mln private placement.

text.p: Phoenix Network Inc said Monday that it has completed the sale of $2.5 million in convertible preferred shares through a private placement.
The company said that it has received $1.5 million from the transaction and will receive the rest of the money within six days.
Phoenix said the cash satisfies its short-term working capital needs and gives it the time needed to turn the company's cash flow positive.
Future financings, said Phoenix, will enable it to pursue acquisitions. It added that it is making progress in talks with potential acquisition candidates.
Phoenix is an inter-exchange carrier which offers long-distance and other telecommunication services.
